description: This file defines a class 'BaseLLMAIOHTTPHandler' that manages asynchronous and synchronous HTTP communication with language models and image variation services using aiohttp and httpx. It handles session and transport management, API calls (including retries), error handling, and response transformation, supporting both stream and non-stream modes for chat completion and image variation endpoints.
